assumptions: All package pp figures below are ceilings before service charge and tax, not vendor prices or availability.
Package must include dinner, staff and hosted beer/wine/soft drinks for agreed reception duration; toast/coffee alone do not establish included hosted bar.

Service percentages of 20%, 22% and 25% are wedding scenarios, not verified wedding terms. A separate 2026 golf-outing menu lists 20%. The 9% food/beverage tax combines Prince William 3% with Virginia 6%; quote classification controls actual tax.
Site/ceremony/extra-hour/security/other fee allowances0/1000/2500 are total all-in burdens inclusive of their own service/tax. Zero does not mean no fees.

Main matrix preserves prior spec assumption that setup/breakdown is included. Website says service personnel, not an explicit setup/breakdown promise. Conservative sensitivity adds model labor/delivery/tax.
Getting-ready cost omitted because private bride/bridal-party and groomsmen changing areas are advertised; access hours and suitability still require confirmation.
Cake purchase $1630 retained; cake cutting included based on official wording.
Onsite parking does NOT establish free parking: model retains $1110 (74 cars x$15) in every main scenario.
All unpriced costs must fit the fee allowance. A $1000 cushion is additional room below the venue limit, separate from untouched total-budget reserve.
No assumed day-of-coordinator savings are applied to venue costs or limits.
formula: floor_to_cent((32139 - cushion - 1630 cake - 1110 parking - all_in_fee_allowance) / (185 * (1 + service_pct) * 1.09))
